Exuviation, a melee ability and fire, wind and ice spells are recommended.
entries.Translated:
会有所有魔法伤害被反射的阶段。
推荐携带蜕皮、一个近战技能以及火、风、冰魔法。

entries.Original:
Requirements for achievement: Take no damage, use all 6 magic elements,
use all 3 melee types, kill all 3 clones in act3 and finish faster than ideal time.
entries.Translated:
成就要求：不承受任何伤害，使用全部6种魔法元素，
使用全部3种近战类型，在第三幕中击杀全部3个分身并在理想时间内完成。
超硬化！（多次全屏 + 击退）

entries.Original: Spawns hands. Focus left hand first.
entries.Translated: 生成大手。优先攻击左手。

entries.Original: Prepare to use Excuviation to remove debuff
entries.Translated: 准备使用蜕皮移除减益

entries.Original: will drain all your MP, kill it fast!
entries.Translated: 将吸取你所有MP，尽快击杀它！

entries.Original: will do multiple raidwides, kill it fast!
entries.Translated: 将进行多次全屏攻击，尽快击杀它！

entries.Original: You were doomed! Cleanse it with Exuviation.
entries.Translated: 你被死亡宣告了！使用蜕皮除垢。

entries.Original:
will cast Throttle on you which needs to be
cleansed with Excuviation. It will also spawn two hands which need to be
killed asap. Focus the left hand first because it will drain all your MP.
entries.Translated:
将对你施放蛇喉，需要使用
蜕皮除垢。它还会生成两只大手，需要
尽快击杀。优先攻击左手，因为它会吸取你所有MP。

entries.Original: Pyretic, stop everything! Dodge the AOE after it runs out.
entries.Translated: 热病，停止一切行动！效果结束后躲避AOE。

entries.Original:
For this act Exuviation and Diamondback are mandatory.
Bringing Flying Sardine, lightning and wind spells is higly recommended.
entries.Translated:
本幕必须携带蜕皮和超硬化。
强烈推荐携带投掷沙丁鱼以及雷、风魔法。

entries.Original:
will spawn upto 4 waves of adds which are weak to fire.
A way to quickly heal yourself to full is mandatory and a ranged fire
ability such as Mustard Bomb and Flying Sardine for interrupts
are highly recommended.
entries.Translated:
将生成最多4波弱火的小怪。
必须携带快速回满血量的手段，强烈推荐携带远程火
技能如芥末爆弹以及用于打断的投掷沙丁鱼。

entries.Original:
will cast Raw Instinct, which causes all his hits to crit.
Use Eerie Soundwave to dispel it.
entries.Translated:
将施放野兽的直觉，使其所有攻击必定暴击。
使用怪音波驱散它。

entries.Original: is weak against earth and strong against lightning attacks.
Electrocution on you! Cleanse it with Exuviation.
entries.Translated: 你身上有感电！用蜕皮解除。

entries.Original:
will cast Alternate Plumage, which makes him almost
immune to damage. Use Eerie Soundwave to dispel it. Caber Toss must be
interrupted or you will wipe.
Additionally Exuviation and earth spells are recommended for act 2.
entries.Translated:
将施放换羽，使其几乎
免疫伤害。使用怪音波驱散它。投掷必须
打断，否则会团灭。
此外，第二幕推荐使用蜕皮和土属性法术。

entries.Original: Windburn on you! Cleanse it with Exuviation.
entries.Translated: 你身上有裂伤！用蜕皮解除。

entries.Original:
Bait the Meteor to the edge of the arena!
Use Loom to escape or Diamondback to survive.
entries.Translated:
将黄道陨石引到场地边缘！
使用隐遁逃脱或超硬化存活。

entries.Original:
will switch between magic and physical reflects.
Spend attention to that so you don't accidently kill yourself.
As soon as he starts casting Web go to the edge to bait Meteor, then use Loom
to escape. You can start the Final Sting combination at about 50% health left.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
将在魔法反射和物理反射之间切换。
注意这一点，以免误杀自己。
一旦他开始施放蛛网，就前往边缘引诱黄道陨石，然后使用隐遁
逃脱。大约剩余50%血量时可以开始终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original: You were doomed! Cleanse it with Exuviation or finish the act fast.
entries.Translated: 你被注定了！用蜕皮解除或尽快结束此幕。

entries.Original:
will reflect all magic attacks.
He will also spawn adds that need to be dealed with swiftly
since they will spam raidwides. The adds are immune against magic
and fire attacks.
entries.Translated:
将反射所有魔法攻击。
他还会生成需要迅速处理的小怪，
因为它们会不断施放全屏攻击。这些小怪免疫魔法
和火属性攻击。

entries.Original: ! Use physical attacks except fire aspected.
entries.Translated: ！使用物理攻击，但不要用火属性。

entries.Original:
will reflect all physical damage in act 1, all magic damage in act 2
and switch between both in act 3. Loom, Exuviation and Diamondback
are recommended. In act 3 can start the Final Sting combination
at about 50% health left. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
在第一幕反射所有物理伤害，第二幕反射所有魔法伤害，
第三幕在两者之间切换。推荐使用隐遁、蜕皮和超硬化。
第三幕大约剩余50%血量时可以开始终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original:
Requirements for achievement: Take no damage, use all 6 magic elements,
use all 3 melee types and finish faster than ideal time
entries.Translated:
成就要求：不受任何伤害，使用全部6种魔法元素，
使用全部3种近战类型，并在理想时间之前完成

entries.Original:
fast or wipe!
Use ranged physical attacks.
entries.Translated:
尽快否则团灭！
使用远程物理攻击。

entries.Original:
spawns two adds when casting Boneshaker. These should be a
priority or they will explode and wipe you. To kill them without touching
the electric field use a ranged physical attack such as Fire Angon.
You can start the Final Sting combination at about 50% health left.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
施放骨震时会生成两只小怪。应优先
处理，否则它们会爆炸并导致团灭。要在不触碰
灵变电火花的情况下击杀它们，请使用远程物理攻击，如火投枪。
大约剩余50%血量时可以开始终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original:
casts Silence which should be interrupted.
Condensed Libra puts a debuff on you. Use Diamondback to survive the
following attack. Alternatively you can cleanse the debuff with Exuviation.
entries.Translated:
施放宁静冰洞，应打断。
小侦测会给你施加一个减益。使用超硬化存活于
随后的攻击。或者你可以用蜕皮解除该减益。

entries.Original:
is immune to
physical attacks. For the 2nd act Diamondback is highly recommended.
For the 3rd act a ranged physical spell such as Fire Angon
is highly recommended.
entries.Translated:
免疫
物理攻击。第二幕强烈推荐超硬化。
第三幕强烈推荐使用远程物理法术，如火投枪。

entries.Original:
will use Ecliptic Meteor.
Use Diamondback to survive it.
You can start the Final Sting combination at about 40% health left.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
将使用黄道陨石。
使用超硬化存活。
大约剩余40%血量时可以开始终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original: Wipe if Grenade is not killed yet, otherwise Raidwide
entries.Translated: 若榴弹怪尚未被击杀则团灭，否则全屏

entries.Original:
spawns grenades and gas bombs during the fight. Just as in
act 1 the grenades must be killed in one hit each or they will wipe you.
Use Sticky Tongue to pull Gas Bombs to the boss so they interrupt the enrage.
You can start the Final Sting combination at about 50% health left.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
战斗中会生成榴弹怪和毒气弹。正如
第一幕，榴弹怪必须一击击杀，否则会团灭。
使用滑舌将毒气弹拉向Boss，以打断狂暴。
大约剩余50%血量时可以开始终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original: in one hit or it will wipe you! It got 543 HP.
entries.Translated: 一击击杀，否则会团灭！它有543点生命值。

entries.Original: Use Sticky Tongue to pull the

to the bos
to interrupt the enrage!

The first act is easy. Kill the grenades in one hit each or they will wipe you.
If you gear is bad consider using 1000 Needles.
For the 2nd act you should bring Sticky Tongue. In the 2nd act you can start
the Final Sting combination at about 50%
health left. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
第一幕很简单。将榴弹怪一击击杀，否则会团灭。
如果装备不好，考虑使用千针刺。
第二幕应带上滑舌。第二幕中大约剩余50%
血量时可以开始终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original: Kill the grenades in one hit each or they will wipe you. They got 543 HP.
entries.Translated: 将榴弹怪一击击杀，否则会团灭。它们有543点生命值。

entries.Original:
Interrupt The Rams Keeper with Flying Sardine. You can start the
Final Sting combination at about 50% health left.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting).
The boss will sometimes spawn an Arena Imp during the fight.
entries.Translated:
用飞沙丁鱼打断公羊守护者。大约剩余50%血量时
可以开始终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）。
Boss有时会在战斗中生成竞技场小恶魔。

entries.Original:
The imps are weak to fire spells and strong against ice.
Interrupt Void Blizzard with Flying Sardine.
entries.Translated:
小恶魔弱火属性魔法，抗冰属性。
用投掷沙丁鱼打断虚空冰结。

entries.Original:
The first act is fairly easy. Interrupt the Void Blizzards with Flying
Sardine and most of the danger is gone. The Imps are weak against fire spells.
In the 2nd act you can start the Final Sting combination at about 50%
health left. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
第一幕相当简单。用投掷沙丁鱼打断虚空冰结后，大部分危险就解除了。小恶魔弱火属性魔法。
第二幕中，可以在血量约剩50%时开始终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original:
This act is act 1+2 combined with tentacles on top.
The Final Sting combo (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting) makes
this act including the achievement much easier.
entries.Translated:
这一幕是第一幕和第二幕的结合，外加触手。
终极针连招（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）能让这一幕包括成就变得容易很多。

entries.Original: Requirement for achievement: Don't kill any tentacles in this act
entries.Translated: 成就要求：这一幕中不击杀任何触手

entries.Original: is weak to fire. Interrupt Imp Song.
entries.Translated: 弱火属性。打断河童之歌。

entries.Original:
Diamondback and Flying Sardine are essential for this stage. The Final
Sting combo (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting) can make act 3
including the achievement much easier. Ultros in act 2 and 3 is weak to
fire.
entries.Translated: 超硬化和投掷沙丁鱼在这一阶段至关重要。终极针连招（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）能让第三幕包括成就变得容易很多。第二幕和第三幕的奥尔特罗斯弱火属性。

entries.Original: Requirement for achievement: Don't kill any tentacles in act 3
entries.Translated: 成就要求：第三幕中不击杀任何触手

entries.Original: Cast Ink Jet on boss to get blinded!
entries.Translated: 对Boss施放喷墨来致盲自己！

entries.Original: Boss will reflect all magic damage!

Same as first act, but this time the boss will cast a gaze from all directions.
The easiest counter for this is to blind yourself by casting Ink Jet on the
boss after it casted Schizocarps.
The Final Sting combo window opens at around 75% health.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
和第一幕相同，但这次Boss会从所有方向施放凝视。
最简单的应对方法是在Boss施放播种后，对其施放喷墨来致盲自己。
终极针连招窗口在血量约75%时开启。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original:
At the start of the fight Rebekkah will cast Reflect. This will reflect all
magic damage back to you. Useful skills: Sharpened Knife,
Flying Sardine, Ink Jet (Act 2), Exuviation (Act 2), potentially a Final Sting
combo. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated: 战斗开始时，Rebekkah会施放反射。这会将所有魔法伤害反射回你身上。有用的技能：锋利菜刀、投掷沙丁鱼、喷墨（第二幕）、蜕皮（第二幕），可能还有终极针连招。（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original:
Same as last stage. Make the manticores run to the kegs and their attacks
will make them blow up. Their attacks will also do friendly fire damage
to each other.
The Ram's Voice and Ultravibration combo can be used to kill manticores.
entries.Translated:
和上一阶段相同。让蝎尾狮跑向酒桶，它们的攻击会引爆酒桶。它们的攻击也会对彼此造成友方伤害。
寒冰咆哮和超振动连招可以用来击杀蝎尾狮。

entries.Original:
Make the manticores run to the kegs and their attacks will make them
blow up. They take 2500 damage per keg explosion.
The Ram's Voice and Ultravibration combo can be used to kill manticores.
entries.Translated:
让蝎尾狮跑向酒桶，它们的攻击会引爆酒桶。每个酒桶爆炸造成2500点伤害。
寒冰咆哮和超振动连招可以用来击杀蝎尾狮。

entries.Original:
is weak to lightning spells.
During the fight he will spawn one of each claws as known from act 1.
If available use the Ram's Voice + Ultravibration combo for instant kill.
entries.Translated:
弱雷光属性魔法。
战斗中他会生成第一幕中已知的每种爪子各一个。
如果有条件，使用寒冰咆哮+超振动连招来秒杀。

entries.Original:
counters physical
attacks. If you have healing spells you can just tank the counter damage
and kill them however you like anyway. All opponents in this stage are
weak to lightning.
The Ram's Voice and Ultravibration combo can be used in Act 2.
entries.Translated:
闪身拳物理攻击。如果你有治疗魔法，可以直接硬抗闪身拳伤害，随意击杀它们。这一阶段的所有对手都弱雷光属性。
第二幕中可以使用寒冰咆哮和超振动连招。

entries.Original:
will spawn a cyclops a few seconds into the fight. Make sure
to kill it before it reaches you. After that you can just slowly take down the
boss. Use Diamondback to survive the 1111 Tonze Swing. Alternatively
you can try the Final Sting combo when he drops to about 75% health.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
会在战斗开始几秒后生成一个独眼巨人。确保在它接近你之前将其击杀。之后你就可以慢慢击败Boss了。使用超硬化来在1111吨重挥击中存活。或者，当他血量降到约75%时，你可以尝试终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original:
The cyclops are very slow, but will instantly kill you, if they catch you.
Kite them or kill them with the self-destruct combo. (Toad Oil->Bristle->
Moonflute->Swiftcast->Self-destruct) If you don't use the self-destruct
combo in act 1, you can bring the Final Sting combo for act 2.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
Diamondback is highly recommended in act 2.
entries.Translated:
独眼巨人非常缓慢，但如果它们抓住你会立即将你击杀。
风筝它们，或用自爆连招击杀它们。（油性分泌物→怒发冲冠→月笛→即刻咏唱→自爆）如果你在第一幕不使用自爆连招，可以为第二幕带上终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）
第二幕强烈推荐超硬化。

entries.Original:
For this stage Flying Sardine and Acorn Bomb are highly recommended.
Use Flying Sardine to interrupt High Voltage.
Use Acorn Bomb to put Shabtis to sleep until their buff runs out.
entries.Translated:
这一阶段强烈推荐投掷沙丁鱼和橡果炸弹。
使用投掷沙丁鱼打断高压电流。
使用橡果炸弹让沙布提斯沉睡，直到其增益效果消失。

entries.Original: Use the cube to take cover!

Same as first act, but the slimes will apply heavy to you.
Use Loom to get out of line of sight as soon as Final Song gets casted.
entries.Translated:
和第一幕相同，但史莱姆会对你施加加重。
一旦最后之歌开始施放，立即使用织网脱离视线范围。

entries.Original:
These slimes start casting Final Song after death.
While Final Song is not deadly, it does heavy damage and applies silence
to you. Take cover! For act 2 the spell Loom is strongly recommended.
The slimes are strong against blunt melee damage such as J Kick.
entries.Translated:
这些史莱姆死亡后开始施放最后之歌。
虽然最后之歌不致命，但会造成大量伤害并施加宁静冰洞。躲避！第二幕强烈推荐织网魔法。
史莱姆抗打击类近战伤害，如J踢。

entries.Original: Harmless raidwide unless you failed to kill succubus in time
entries.Translated: 无害的全屏攻击，除非你未能及时击杀梦魔

entries.Original:
will cast various AOEs and summons adds.
Interrupt the adds with Flying Sardine and kill them fast.
If the add is still alive during the next Black Sabbath, you will be wiped.
entries.Translated:
会施放各种AOE并召唤小怪。
用投掷沙丁鱼打断小怪并快速击杀它们。
如果小怪在下一次黑色安息日时仍然存活，你们将被团灭。

entries.Original:
The first act is trivial, almost anything will work.
For act 2 having Flying Sardine is recommended.
entries.Translated:
第一幕很简单，几乎任何技能都行。
第二幕推荐带上投掷沙丁鱼。

entries.Original: Calls Roselets. Prepare Ice Spikes if available.
entries.Translated: 召唤玫瑰幼虫。如果有冰棘，请准备好。

entries.Original:
when he casts Inflammable Fumes.
Use Ice Spikes to instantly kill roselets once they become aggressive.
entries.Translated:
当他施放易燃烟雾时。
使用冰棘在玫瑰幼虫变得具有攻击性时立即击杀它们。

entries.Original: is weak against water and strong against earth spells.
entries.Translated: 弱水属性，抗土属性魔法。

entries.Original:
For this stage Ice Spikes and Bomb Toss are recommended spells.
Use Ice Spikes to instantly kill roselets once they become aggressive.
Hydnora in act 2 is weak against water and strong against earth spells.
entries.Translated:
这一阶段推荐冰棘和炸弹投掷魔法。
使用冰棘在玫瑰幼虫变得具有攻击性时立即击杀它们。
第二幕的Hydnora弱水属性，抗土属性魔法。

entries.Original:
Same as last act, but this time there are 4 bombs. Pull them to the
middle with Sticky Tongue and attack them with any AOE to keep them
interrupted. They are weak against wind and strong against fire.
entries.Translated: 和上一幕相同，但这次有4个炸弹。用粘舌将它们拉到中间，并用任意AOE攻击它们以保持打断。它们弱风属性，抗火属性。

entries.Original:
These bombs start self-destruction on combat start. Pull them together
with Sticky Tongue and attack them with anything to interrupt them.
They are weak against wind and strong against fire.
entries.Translated: 这些炸弹在战斗开始时开始自爆。用粘舌将它们拉到一起，并用任意技能攻击它们以打断。它们弱风属性，抗火属性。

entries.Original:
will cast King's Will during the fight. Interrupt it with
Flying Sardine or he will become stronger each time. After 3 casts he
starts using the interruptible enrage Black Nebula.
entries.Translated: 会在战斗中施放王之意志。用投掷沙丁鱼打断它，否则他每次都会变得更强。施放3次后，他开始使用可打断的狂暴技能黑色星云。

entries.Original:
summons a total of 6 adds during the fight, one of each element.
Healer mimikry can be helpful if you have trouble surviving.
entries.Translated:
战斗中总共召唤 6 个小怪，每种元素各一个。
如果你难以存活，治疗拟态会很有帮助。

entries.Original:
Clever activation of cherry bombs will freeze the Progenitrix.
Interrupt its burst skill or wipe. The Progenitrix is weak to wind spells.
entries.Translated:
巧妙引爆爆弹仔将使爆弹之母冻结。
打断其爆发技能，否则团灭。爆弹之母弱风属性法术。

entries.Original:
For this stage the spell Flying Sardine to interrupt the Progenitrix in Act 2
